requirements.text: * You have 15+ years of experience designing and delivering large-scale distributed systems, developer platforms, AI platforms, or infrastructure services.
* You have a track record of setting strategy and technical direction across teams, then carrying it through implementation and production operation.
* You have strong expertise in agentic platform architecture and experience creating platform capabilities that make agent development and operation effective for application teams.
* You have hands-on experience with agentic frameworks such as Mastra AI and LangChain/LangGraph, including the ability to evaluate their tradeoffs and establish scalable platform patterns.
* You have experience designing model gateways, inference platforms, model-serving systems, model orchestration layers, or equivalent shared services.
* You have experience evaluating models against real workloads, with a practical understanding of quality, latency, throughput, reliability, and cost tradeoffs.
